text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I spot Bamboo Memory practicing her dancing as I'm passing by the lesson rooms.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Hmph! Hmph! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And take that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her methodical choreography and determined expression are captivating. However…
choice_data_list: That's a pretty… intense dance for such a light song.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ngh! So the choreography really doesn't fit, huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: My dance teacher said the same thing, so I've been trying to figure something out.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But no matter how many times I change it, it ends up the same. I can't capture the vibe of the song…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Uggghhh! What should I do?!
choice_data_list: Relax a bit and loosen up your shoulders.
Is there anyone you could emulate?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Relax? But how?
choice_data_list: Try to think of something funny.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Something funny, huh? Something funny… Hmmm… I mean, there should be so many things to choose from…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory seems totally lost. In that case…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I cover my face with both hands and then open them to reveal a ridiculous face!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Pfft! Hehe… What the heck kinda face is that, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I don't know if "like" is the right word, but…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha! No fair, I wasn't ready! That's against the rules!
choice_data_list: There's more where that came from!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah! You've gotta stop! My abs can't take any more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After having some fun and loosening up, Bamboo Memory is finally able to match her movements to the song.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I see! So I should copy someone first!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Let's see… Oguri seems like she'd make the best model out of everyone I know.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: She's always so naturally calm. I think she'd be a perfect fit for this song!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I feel so at ease when I'm with her. In fact, we usually end up doing everything at her speed—in a good way!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: She's the same in her races too! She's so free, but so fast… Watching her really tugs at the heartstrings!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: When she runs like that, I… I…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hrng… Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Just thinking about her makes me want to run so bad!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Trainer! I've got to run off all this energy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory dashes away to the training track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's not exactly what I planned, but after she releases all her pent-up energy, she manages to relax and dance along to the song.
